description: This file defines a class Kint_Parsers_objectIterateable that extends kintParser, intended to parse iterable objects, particularly those implementing Traversable, to extract their contents.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_objectIterateable
classes.description: A parser class designed to handle iterable objects and extract their contents for inspection.
